visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with an indoor shot of a retro-themed restaurant where a single customer with a ponytail is seated at a wooden counter facing a large glass window. Outside, a city street with several plants and shop signs is visible under bright, natural daylight. The interior features warm wooden textures and small decorative toys on shelves. (2) A transition shows the restaurant's entrance, featuring a vintage-style cinema marquee labeled 'MATALAY THEATRE' with specific showtimes listed. Below the board is a bright pink neon sign depicting a cartoon woman in a traditional cheongsam making a finger-heart gesture. The wall is dark wood, creating a high-contrast cinematic lighting effect. (3) The scene shifts to a series of fast-cut close-ups of Southeast Asian cuisine. Chopsticks are seen lifting thick yellow noodles coated in a vibrant orange sauce. A bowl of curry noodles with large shrimp, bean sprouts, and green herbs is showcased. The lighting is focused and bright, highlighting the glossy textures of the food. (4) Further food items are presented, including a savory bowl of pork knuckle soup with green vegetables and a plate of minced meat served with a sunny-side-up egg and broccoli. Macro close-ups show radish cakes being dipped into a thick, creamy peanut-based sauce and spring rolls filled with shrimp and onions being held up. (5) The final sequence displays various beverages being poured from plastic bottles into glasses filled with ice, specifically a milky tea and a citrus drink. The camera pans through the dining area showing green and white walls adorned with retro movie posters before concluding with a wide shot of the restaurant's large exterior billboard.
